_about: The /fitness hero: a goal picker that loads a barbell, lays out a typical week, shows one field-guide entry and rings the tools and areas that fit.
scripts/build_fitness.py checks this file against the field guide and writes it into the hub (the buttons as HTML, the rest as JSON for /fitness.js).

pct is the share of the visitor's best squat the bar loads. pct_from names the entry that gives that share; null means the share is an example, because the guide gives reps for that goal, not a percentage, and the page says so.
days is the lifting days a week. A goal without its own days uses days_by_level, from days_from.
by_level overrides any of pct, pct_from, how, entry, areas, vantix, week for one level: new (under a year), mid (1 to 3 years), adv (3+ years).
h1 finishes the headline "Tools & notes for people who ..." once the goal is picked.
A week is seven rows, Monday first: [kind, name, what happens]. kind is lift, cardio, rest or meet. The weeks are example templates, not programmes from the guide.
